title: Virgo proofreads "on my way."
caption:
Virgo proofreads "on my way." and adds a semicolon. Gemini sends three voice notes in a row, then a fourth. Scorpio texts "home safe?" at 11 PM and checks again at 11:01.
Which texter are you?
